races.name: Aasimar

traits.name: Ability Score Increase
traits.description: Your Charisma score increases by 2.

traits.name: Age
traits.description: Aasimar mature at the same rate as humans, but they can live up to 160 years.

traits.name: Alignment
traits.description: Imbued with celestial power, most aasimar are good. Outcast aasimar are most often neutral or even evil.

traits.name: Size
traits.description: Aasimar have the same range of height and weight as humans.

traits.name: Speed
traits.description: Your base walking speed is 30 feet.

traits.name: Darkvision
traits.description: Blessed with a radiant soul, your vision can easily cut through darkness. You can see in dim light within 60 feet of you as if it were bright light, and in darkness as if it were dim light. You can't discern color in darkness, only shades of gray.

traits.name: Celestial Resistance
traits.description: You have resistance to necrotic damage and radiant damage.

traits.name: Healing Hands
traits.description: As an action, you can touch a creature and cause it to regain a number of hit points equal to your level. Once you use this trait, you can't use it again until you finish a long rest.

traits.name: Light Bearer
traits.description: You know the light cantrip. Charisma is your spellcasting ability for it.

traits.name: Languages
traits.description: You can speak, read, and write Common and Celestial.

traits.name: Subrace
traits.description: Three subraces of aasimar exist: protector aasimar, scourge aasimar, and fallen aasimar. Choose one of them for your character.

subraces.name: Protector Aasimar

traits.name: Ability Score Increase
traits.description: Your Wisdom score increases by 1.

traits.name: Radiant Soul
traits.description: Starting at 3rd level, you can use your action to unleash the divine energy within yourself, causing your eyes to glimmer and two luminous, incorporeal wings to sprout from your back. Your transformation lasts for 1 minute or until you end it as a bonus action. During it, you have a flying speed of 30 feet, and once on each of your turns, you can deal extra radiant damage to one target when you deal damage to it with an attack or a spell. The extra radiant damage equals your level. Once you use this trait, you can't use it again until you finish a long rest.

subraces.description: Protector aasimar are charged by the powers of good to guard the weak, to strike at evil wherever it arises, and to stand vigilant against the darkness. From a young age, a protector aasimar receives advice and directives that urge to stand against evil.

subraces.name: Scourge Aasimar

traits.name: Ability Score Increase
traits.description: Your Constitution score increases by 1.

traits.name: Radiant Consumption
traits.description: Starting at 3rd level, you can use your action to unleash the divine energy within yourself, causing a searing light to radiate from you, pour out of your eyes and mouth, and threaten to char you. Your transformation lasts for 1 minute or until you end it as a bonus action. During it, you shed bright light in a 10-foot radius and dim light for an additional 10 feet, and at the end of each of your turns, you and each creature within 10 feet of you take radiant damage equal to half your level (rounded up). In addition, once on each of your turns, you can deal extra radiant damage to one target when you deal damage to it with an attack or a spell. The extra radiant damage equals your level. Once you use this trait, you can't use it again until you finish a long rest.

subraces.description: Scourge aasimar are imbued with a divine energy that blazes intensely within them. It feeds a powerful desire to destroy evil-a desire that is, at its best, unflinching and, at its worst, all-consuming. Many scourge aasimar wear masks to block out the world and focus on containing this power, unmasking themselves only in battle.

subraces.name: Fallen Aasimar

traits.name: Ability Score Increase
traits.description: Your Strength score increases by 1.

traits.name: Necrotic Shroud
traits.description: Starting at 3rd level, you can use your action to unleash the divine energy within yourself, causing your eyes to turn into pools of darkness and two skeletal, ghostly, flightless wings to sprout from your back. The instant you transform, other creatures within 10 feet of you that can see you must each succeed on a Charisma saving throw (DC 8 + your proficiency bonus + your Charisma modifier) or become frightened of you until the end of your next turn. Your transformation lasts for 1 minute or until you end it as a bonus action. During it, once on each of your turns, you can deal extra necrotic damage to one target when you deal damage to it with an attack or a spell. The extra necrotic damage equals your level. Once you use this trait, you can't use it again until you finish a long rest.

subraces.description: An aasimar who was touched by dark powers as a youth or who turns to evil in early adulthood can become one of the fallen-a group of aasimar whose inner light has been replaced by shadow.

races.description: Aasimar are mortals of celestial origin, bearing a radiant soul that marks them as descendants of angels. They resemble humans in stature and appearance, often with an otherworldly presence that hints at their divine heritage.

Age.notes: Matures at same rate as humans, lives up to 160 years.

Size.notes: Medium size; same height and weight range as humans.

Healing Hands.notes: As an action, touch a creature to restore hit points equal to your level. Usable once per long rest.

Light Bearer.notes: Know the light cantrip. Charisma is the spellcasting ability for it.

Languages.notes: Can speak, read, and write Common and Celestial.

Subrace.notes: Choose a subrace: protector, scourge, or fallen aasimar.

races.name: Firbolg

traits.name: Ability Score Increase
traits.description: Your Wisdom score increases by 2, and your Strength score increases by 1.

traits.name: Age
traits.description: As humanoids related to the fey, firbolg have long lifespans. A firbolg reaches adulthood around 30, and the oldest of them can live for 500 years.

traits.name: Alignment
traits.description: As people who follow the rhythm of nature and see themselves as its caretakers, firbolg are typically neutral good. Evil firbolg are rare and are usually the sworn enemies of the rest of their kind.

traits.name: Size
traits.description: Firbolg are between 7 and 8 feet tall and weigh between 240 and 300 pounds. Your size is Medium.

traits.name: Speed
traits.description: Your base walking speed is 30 feet.

traits.name: Firbolg Magic
traits.description: You can cast detect magic and disguise self with this trait, using Wisdom as your spellcasting ability for them. Once you cast either spell, you can't cast it again with this trait until you finish a short or long rest. When you use this version of disguise self, you can seem up to 3 feet shorter than normal, allowing you to more easily blend in with humans and elves.

traits.name: Hidden Step
traits.description: As a bonus action, you can magically turn invisible until the start of your next turn or until you attack, make a damage roll, or force someone to make a saving throw. Once you use this trait, you can't use it again until you finish a short or long rest.

traits.name: Powerful Build
traits.description: You count as one size larger when determining your carrying capacity and the weight you can push, drag, or lift.

traits.name: Speech of Beast and Leaf
traits.description: You have the ability to communicate in a limited manner with beasts and plants. They can understand the meaning of your words, though you have no special ability to understand them in return. You have advantage on all Charisma checks you make to influence them.

traits.name: Languages
traits.description: You can speak, read, and write Common, Elvish, and Giant.

races.description: Firbolg are between 7 and 8 feet tall and weigh between 240 and 300 pounds. As humanoids related to the fey, they have long lifespans and follow the rhythm of nature as its caretakers.

Firbolg Magic.notes: Can cast detect magic and disguise self (Wisdom as spellcasting ability); each usable once per short or long rest; disguise self variant can appear up to 3 feet shorter

Hidden Step.notes: Bonus action to turn invisible until start of next turn or until attacking, dealing damage, or forcing a save; once per short or long rest

Powerful Build.notes: Count as one size larger for carrying capacity and push/drag/lift weight

Speech of Beast and Leaf.notes: Can communicate limited meaning to beasts and plants; advantage on Charisma checks to influence them

Languages.notes: Speak, read, and write Common, Elvish, and Giant

races.name: Goliath

traits.name: Ability Score Increase
traits.description: Your Strength score increases by 2, and your Constitution score increases by 1.

traits.name: Age
traits.description: Goliaths have lifespans comparable to humans. They enter adulthood in their late teens and usually live less than a century.

traits.name: Alignment
traits.description: Goliath society, with its clear roles and tasks, has a strong lawful bent. The goliath sense of fairness, balanced with an emphasis on self-sufficiency and personal accountability, pushes them toward neutrality.

traits.name: Size
traits.description: Goliaths are between 7 and 8 feet tall and weigh between 280 and 340 pounds. Your size is Medium.

traits.name: Speed
traits.description: Your base walking speed is 30 feet.

traits.name: Natural Athlete
traits.description: You have proficiency in the Athletics skill.

traits.name: Stone's Endurance
traits.description: You can focus yourself to occasionally shrug off injury. When you take damage, you can use your reaction to roll a d12. Add your Constitution modifier to the number rolled, and reduce the damage by that total. After you use this trait, you can't use it again until you finish a short or long rest.

traits.name: Powerful Build
traits.description: You count as one size larger when determining your carrying capacity and the weight you can push, drag, or lift.

traits.name: Mountain Born
traits.description: You're acclimated to high altitude, including elevations above 20,000 feet. You're also naturally adapted to cold climates, as described in chapter 5 of the Dungeon Master's Guide.

traits.name: Languages
traits.description: You can speak, read, and write Common and Giant.

races.description: Goliaths are between 7 and 8 feet tall and weigh between 280 and 340 pounds, with a strong lawful bent and a sense of fairness balanced by self-sufficiency.

Stone's Endurance.notes: Reaction to reduce damage by 1d12 + Constitution modifier; usable once per short or long rest

Powerful Build.notes: Count as one size larger for carrying capacity and push/drag/lift weight

Mountain Born.notes: Acclimated to high altitude; naturally adapted to cold climates

Languages.notes: Can speak, read, and write Common and Giant

races.name: Kenku

traits.name: Ability Score Increase
traits.description: Your Dexterity score increases by 2.

traits.name: Age
traits.description: Kenku have shorter lifespans than humans. They reach maturity at about 12 years old and can live to 60.

traits.name: Alignment
traits.description: Kenku are chaotic creatures, rarely making enduring commitments, and they care mostly for themselves. They lean toward chaotic alignments.

traits.name: Size
traits.description: Kenku are around 5 feet tall and weigh between 90 and 120 pounds. Your size is Medium.

traits.name: Speed
traits.description: Your base walking speed is 30 feet.

traits.name: Expert Forgery
traits.description: You can duplicate other creatures' handwriting and craftwork. You have advantage on all checks made to produce forgeries or duplicates of existing objects.

traits.name: Kenku Training
traits.description: You are proficient in your choice of two of the following skills: Acrobatics, Deception, Stealth, and Sleight of Hand.

traits.name: Mimicry
traits.description: You can mimic sounds you have heard, including voices. A creature that hears the sounds you make can tell they are imitations with a successful Wisdom (Insight) check opposed by your Charisma (Deception) check.

traits.name: Languages
traits.description: You can read and write Common and Auran, but you can speak only by using your Mimicry trait.

races.description: Kenku are around 5 feet tall and weigh between 90 and 120 pounds, resembling humanoid crows with feathers and beaks.

Expert Forgery.notes: Advantage on all checks made to produce forgeries or duplicates of existing objects.

Kenku Training.notes: Proficient in your choice of two of the listed skills.

Mimicry.notes: Can mimic sounds and voices; listeners can detect imitation via Wisdom (Insight) check opposed by your Charisma (Deception) check.

Languages.notes: Can read and write Common and Auran, but can speak only by using the Mimicry trait.

races.name: Lizardfolk

traits.name: Ability Score Increase
traits.description: Your Constitution score increases by 2, and your Wisdom score increases by 1.

traits.name: Age
traits.description: Lizardfolk reach maturity around age 14 and rarely live longer than 60 years.

traits.name: Alignment
traits.description: Most lizardfolk are neutral. They see the world as a place of predators and prey, where life and death are natural processes. They wish only to survive, and prefer to leave other creatures to their own devices.

traits.name: Size
traits.description: Lizardfolk are a little bulkier and taller than humans, and their colorful frills make them appear even larger. Your size is Medium.

traits.name: Speed
traits.description: Your base walking speed is 30 feet, and you have a swimming speed of 30 feet.

traits.name: Bite
traits.description: Your fanged maw is a natural weapon, which you can use to make unarmed strikes. If you hit with it, you deal piercing damage equal to 1d6 + your Strength modifier, instead of the bludgeoning damage normal for an unarmed strike.

traits.name: Cunning Artisan
traits.description: As part of a short rest, you can harvest bone and hide from a slain beast, construct, dragon, monstrosity, or plant creature of size Small or larger to create one of the following items: a shield, a club, a javelin, or 1d4 darts or blowgun needles. To use this trait, you need a blade, such as a dagger, or appropriate artisan's tools, such as leatherworker's tools.

traits.name: Hold Breath
traits.description: You can hold your breath for up to 15 minutes at a time.

traits.name: Hunter's Lore
traits.description: You gain proficiency with two of the following skills of your choice: Animal Handling, Nature, Perception, Stealth, and Survival.

traits.name: Natural Armor
traits.description: You have tough, scaly skin. When you aren't wearing armor, your AC is 13 + your Dexterity modifier. You can use your natural armor to determine your AC if the armor you wear would leave you with a lower AC. A shield's benefits apply as normal while you use your natural armor.

traits.name: Hungry Jaws
traits.description: In battle, you can throw yourself into a vicious feeding frenzy. As a bonus action, you can make a special attack with your bite. If the attack hits, it deals its normal damage, and you gain temporary hit points (minimum of 1) equal to your Constitution modifier, and you can't use this trait again until you finish a short or long rest.

traits.name: Languages
traits.description: You can speak, read, and write Common and Draconic.

races.description: Lizardfolk are a little bulkier and taller than humans, with tough scaly skin and colorful frills that make them appear even larger.

Ability Score Increase.notes: Constitution score increases by 2, Wisdom score increases by 1.

Hungry Jaws.notes: As a bonus action, can make a special bite attack. On hit, deals normal damage and grants temporary hit points (minimum 1) equal to Constitution modifier. Usable once per short or long rest.

Languages.notes: Can speak, read, and write Common and Draconic.

races.name: Tabaxi
languages: one other language of your choice

traits.name: Ability Score Increase
traits.description: Your Dexterity score increases by 2, and your Charisma score increases by 1.

traits.name: Age
traits.description: Tabaxi have lifespans equivalent to humans.

traits.name: Alignment
traits.description: Tabaxi tend toward chaotic alignments, as they let impulse and fancy guide their decisions. They are rarely evil, with most of them driven by curiosity rather than greed or other dark impulses.

traits.name: Size
traits.description: Tabaxi are taller on average than humans and relatively slender. Your size is Medium.

traits.name: Speed
traits.description: Your base walking speed is 30 feet.

traits.name: Darkvision
traits.description: You have a cat's keen senses, especially in the dark. You can see in dim light within 60 feet of you as if it were bright light, and in darkness as if it were dim light. You can't discern color in darkness, only shades of gray.

traits.name: Feline Agility
traits.description: Your reflexes and agility allow you to move with a burst of speed. When you move on your turn in combat, you can double your speed until the end of the turn. Once you use this trait, you can't use it again until you move 0 feet on one of your turns.

traits.name: Cat's Claws
traits.description: Because of your claws, you have a climbing speed of 20 feet. In addition, your claws are natural weapons, which you can use to make unarmed strikes. If you hit with them, you deal slashing damage equal to 1d4 + your Strength modifier, instead of the bludgeoning damage normal for an unarmed strike.

traits.name: Cat's Talent
traits.description: You have proficiency in the Perception and Stealth skills.

traits.name: Languages
traits.description: You can speak, read, and write Common and one other language of your choice.

races.description: Tabaxi are taller on average than humans and relatively slender, with feline features including claws and keen senses.

Feline Agility.notes: Can double speed until end of turn when moving in combat; recharges after moving 0 feet on a turn

Cat's Claws.notes: Climbing speed 20 feet; claws are natural weapons for unarmed strikes dealing 1d4 + Strength modifier slashing damage

Languages.notes: Can speak, read, and write Common and one other language of your choice

races.name: Triton

traits.name: Ability Score Increase
traits.description: Your Strength, Constitution, and Charisma scores each increase by 1.

traits.name: Age
traits.description: Tritons reach maturity around age 15 and can live up to 200 years.

traits.name: Alignment
traits.description: Tritons tend toward lawful good. As guardians of the darkest reaches of the sea, their culture pushes them toward order and benevolence.

traits.name: Size
traits.description: Tritons are slightly shorter than humans, averaging about 5 feet tall. Your size is Medium.

traits.name: Speed
traits.description: Your base walking speed is 30 feet, and you have a swimming speed of 30 feet.

traits.name: Amphibious
traits.description: You can breathe air and water.

traits.name: Control Air and Water
traits.description: A child of the sea, you can call on the magic of elemental air and water. You can cast fog cloud with this trait. Starting at 3rd level, you can cast gust of wind with it, and starting at 5th level, you can also cast wall of water with it (see the spell in the sidebar). Once you cast a spell with this trait, you can't do so again until you finish a long rest. Charisma is your spellcasting ability for these spells.

traits.name: Emissary of the Sea
traits.description: Aquatic beasts have an extraordinary affinity with your people. You can communicate simple ideas with beasts that can breathe water. They can understand the meaning of your words, though you have no special ability to understand them in return.

traits.name: Guardians of the Depths
traits.description: Adapted to even the most extreme ocean depths, you have resistance to cold damage, and you ignore any of the drawbacks caused by a deep, underwater environment.

traits.name: Languages
traits.description: You can speak, read, and write Common and Primordial.

races.description: Tritons are slightly shorter than humans, averaging about 5 feet tall, with a culture that pushes them toward order and benevolence as guardians of the darkest reaches of the sea.

Ability Score Increase.notes: Strength, Constitution, and Charisma scores each increase by 1.

Age.notes: Maturity around age 15; lifespan up to 200 years.

Control Air and Water.notes: Can cast fog cloud (1st level); gust of wind at 3rd level; wall of water at 5th level. Once per long rest each. Charisma is spellcasting ability.

Emissary of the Sea.notes: Can communicate simple ideas with beasts that can breathe water.

Guardians of the Depths.notes: Ignores drawbacks of deep, underwater environment.

Languages.notes: Can speak, read, and write Common and Primordial.

races.name: Bugbear

traits.name: Ability Score Increase
traits.description: Your Strength score increases by 2, and your Dexterity score increases by 1.

traits.name: Age
traits.description: Bugbears reach adulthood at age 16 and live up to 80 years.

traits.name: Alignment
traits.description: Bugbears endure a harsh existence that demands each of them to remain self-sufficient, even at the expense of their fellows. They tend to be chaotic evil.

traits.name: Size
traits.description: Bugbears are between 6 and 8 feet tall and weigh between 250 and 350 pounds. Your size is Medium.

traits.name: Speed
traits.description: Your base walking speed is 30 feet.

traits.name: Darkvision
traits.description: You can see in dim light within 60 feet of you as if it were bright light, and in darkness as if it were dim light. You can't discern color in darkness, only shades of gray.

traits.name: Long-Limbed
traits.description: When you make a melee attack on your turn, your reach for it is 5 feet greater than normal.

traits.name: Powerful Build
traits.description: You count as one size larger when determining your carrying capacity and the weight you can push, drag, or lift.

traits.name: Sneaky
traits.description: You are proficient in the Stealth skill.

traits.name: Surprise Attack
traits.description: If you surprise a creature and hit it with an attack on your first turn in combat, the attack deals an extra 2d6 damage to it. You can use this trait only once per combat.

traits.name: Languages
traits.description: You can speak, read, and write Common and Goblin.

races.description: Bugbears are large, hairy goblinoids that stand between 6 and 8 feet tall and weigh between 250 and 350 pounds, with long limbs and a stealthy demeanor.

Ability Score Increase.notes: Strength score increases by 2, Dexterity score increases by 1.

Long-Limbed.notes: Melee attack reach increased by 5 feet on your turn.

Powerful Build.notes: Count as one size larger for carrying capacity and push/drag/lift weight.

Surprise Attack.notes: Deal extra 2d6 damage on a hit against a surprised creature on your first turn in combat; once per combat.

Languages.notes: Can speak, read, and write Common and Goblin.

races.name: Goblin

traits.name: Ability Score Increase
traits.description: Your Dexterity score increases by 2, and your Constitution score increases by 1.

traits.name: Age
traits.description: Goblins reach adulthood at age 8 and live up to 60 years.

traits.name: Alignment
traits.description: Goblins are typically neutral evil, as they care only for their own needs. A few goblins might tend toward good or neutrality, but only rarely.

traits.name: Size
traits.description: Goblins are between 3 and 4 feet tall and weigh between 40 and 80 pounds. Your size is Small.

traits.name: Speed
traits.description: Your base walking speed is 30 feet.

traits.name: Darkvision
traits.description: You can see in dim light within 60 feet of you as if it were bright light, and in darkness as if it were dim light. You can't discern color in darkness, only shades of gray.

traits.name: Fury of the Small
traits.description: When you damage a creature with an attack or a spell and the creature's size is larger than yours, you can cause the attack or spell to deal extra damage to the creature. The extra damage equals your level. Once you use this trait, you can't use it again until you finish a short or long rest.

traits.name: Nimble Escape
traits.description: You can take the Disengage or Hide action as a bonus action on each of your turns.

traits.name: Languages
traits.description: You can speak, read, and write Common and Goblin.

races.description: Goblins are small, black-hearted humanoids that lair in caves and other despoiled places. They are between 3 and 4 feet tall and weigh between 40 and 80 pounds.

Fury of the Small.notes: Once per short or long rest, when you damage a creature larger than you with an attack or spell, deal extra damage equal to your level

Nimble Escape.notes: Can take the Disengage or Hide action as a bonus action on each of your turns

Languages.notes: Can speak, read, and write Common and Goblin

races.name: Hobgoblin

traits.name: Ability Score Increase
traits.description: Your Constitution score increases by 2, and your Intelligence score increases by 1.

traits.name: Age
traits.description: Hobgoblins mature at the same rate as humans and have lifespans similar in length to theirs.

traits.name: Alignment
traits.description: Hobgoblin society is built on fidelity to a rigid, unforgiving code of conduct. As such, they tend toward lawful evil.

traits.name: Size
traits.description: Hobgoblins are between 5 and 6 feet tall and weigh between 150 and 200 pounds. Your size is Medium.

traits.name: Speed
traits.description: Your base walking speed is 30 feet.

traits.name: Darkvision
traits.description: You can see in dim light within 60 feet of you as if it were bright light, and in darkness as if it were dim light. You can't discern color in darkness, only shades of gray.

traits.name: Martial Training
traits.description: You are proficient with two martial weapons of your choice and with light armor.

traits.name: Saving Face
traits.description: Hobgoblins are careful not to show weakness in front of their allies, for fear of losing status. If you miss with an attack roll or fail an ability check or a saving throw, you can gain a bonus to the roll equal to the number of allies you can see within 30 feet of you (maximum bonus of +5). Once you use this trait, you can't use it again until you finish a short or long rest.

traits.name: Languages
traits.description: You can speak, read, and write Common and Goblin.

races.description: Hobgoblins are between 5 and 6 feet tall and weigh between 150 and 200 pounds, with a rigid, militaristic society.

Ability Score Increase.notes: Constitution score increases by 2, Intelligence score increases by 1.

weapon_profs: Two martial weapons of your choice

Saving Face.notes: Once per short or long rest, when you miss with an attack roll or fail an ability check or saving throw, you can add a bonus equal to the number of allies you can see within 30 feet (max +5) to the roll.

Languages.notes: You can speak, read, and write Common and Goblin.

races.name: Kobold

traits.name: Ability Score Increase
traits.description: Your Dexterity score increases by 2, and your Strength score is reduced by 2.

traits.name: Age
traits.description: Kobolds reach adulthood at age 6 and can live up to 120 years but rarely do so.

traits.name: Alignment
traits.description: Kobolds are fundamentally selfish, making them evil, but their reliance on the strength of their group makes them trend toward law.

traits.name: Size
traits.description: Kobolds are between 2 and 3 feet tall and weigh between 25 and 35 pounds. Your size is Small.

traits.name: Speed
traits.description: Your base walking speed is 30 feet.

traits.name: Darkvision
traits.description: You can see in dim light within 60 feet of you as if it were bright light, and in darkness as if it were dim light. You can't discern color in darkness, only shades of gray.

traits.name: Grovel, Cower, and Beg
traits.description: As an action on your turn, you can cower pathetically to distract nearby foes. Until the end of your next turn, your allies gain advantage on attack rolls against enemies within 10 feet of you that can see you. Once you use this trait, you can't use it again until you finish a short or long rest.

traits.name: Pack Tactics
traits.description: You have advantage on an attack roll against a creature if at least one of your allies is within 5 feet of the creature and the ally isn't incapacitated.

traits.name: Sunlight Sensitivity
traits.description: You have disadvantage on attack rolls and on Wisdom (Perception) checks that rely on sight when you, the target of your attack, or whatever you are trying to perceive is in direct sunlight.

traits.name: Languages
traits.description: You can speak, read, and write Common and Draconic.

races.description: Kobolds are small, reptilian humanoids standing between 2 and 3 feet tall and weighing 25 to 35 pounds, with scaled skin and a draconic heritage.

Ability Score Increase.notes: Dexterity score increases by 2, Strength score is reduced by 2.

Grovel, Cower, and Beg.notes: Action to grant allies advantage on attack rolls against enemies within 10 feet that can see you until end of your next turn; usable once per short or long rest.

Pack Tactics.notes: Advantage on attack rolls against a creature if at least one non-incapacitated ally is within 5 feet of it.

Sunlight Sensitivity.notes: Disadvantage on attack rolls and Wisdom (Perception) checks relying on sight when you, the target, or what you are trying to perceive is in direct sunlight.

Languages.notes: Can speak, read, and write Common and Draconic.

races.name: Orc

traits.name: Aggressive
traits.description: As a bonus action, you can move up to your speed toward an enemy of your choice that you can see or hear. You must end this move closer to the enemy than you started.

traits.name: Menacing
traits.description: You are trained in the Intimidation skill.

traits.name: Powerful Build
traits.description: You count as one size larger when determining your carrying capacity and the weight you can push, drag, or lift.

traits.name: Darkvision
traits.description: You can see in dim light within 60 feet of you as if it were bright light, and in darkness as if it were dim light. You can't discern color in darkness, only shades of gray.

races.description: The provided text does not contain the Orc race entry; it contains stat blocks for Kobold Scale Sorcerer, Korred, Leucrotta, and Meenlock.

Aggressive.notes: Bonus action to move up to your speed toward an enemy you can see or hear, ending closer to it.

Powerful Build.notes: Count as one size larger for carrying capacity and weight you can push, drag, or lift.

races.name: Yuan-ti Pureblood

traits.name: Ability Score Increase
traits.description: Your Charisma score increases by 2, and your Intelligence score increases by 1.

traits.name: Age
traits.description: Purebloods mature at the same rate as humans and have lifespans similar in length to theirs.

traits.name: Alignment
traits.description: Purebloods are devoid of emotion and see others as tools to manipulate. They care little for law or chaos and are typically neutral evil.

traits.name: Size
traits.description: Purebloods match humans in average size and weight. Your size is Medium.

traits.name: Speed
traits.description: Your base walking speed is 30 feet.

traits.name: Darkvision
traits.description: You can see in dim light within 60 feet of you as if it were bright light, and in darkness as if it were dim light. You can't discern color in darkness, only shades of gray.

traits.name: Innate Spellcasting
traits.description: You know the poison spray cantrip. You can cast animal friendship an unlimited number of times with this trait, but you can target only snakes with it. Starting at 3rd level, you can also cast suggestion with this trait. Once you cast it, you can't do so again until you finish a long rest. Charisma is your spellcasting ability for these spells.

traits.name: Magic Resistance
traits.description: You have advantage on saving throws against spells and other magical effects.

traits.name: Poison Immunity
traits.description: You are immune to poison damage and the poisoned condition.

traits.name: Languages
traits.description: You can speak, read, and write Common, Abyssal, and Draconic.

races.description: Yuan-ti purebloods are humanoid serpents who appear mostly human but bear subtle reptilian features such as slit pupils, forked tongues, and patches of scales. They are cold, emotionless schemers who view other creatures as tools to be manipulated.

Innate Spellcasting.notes: Knows poison spray cantrip; can cast animal friendship at will (snakes only); can cast suggestion once per long rest starting at 3rd level; Charisma is spellcasting ability

Magic Resistance.notes: Advantage on saving throws against spells and other magical effects

Languages.notes: Speaks, reads, and writes Common, Abyssal, and Draconic

spells.name: Wall of Water
spells.components: V, S, M (a drop of water)
spells.description: You conjure up a wall of water on the ground at a point you can see within range. You can make the wall up to 30 feet long, 10 feet high, and 1 foot thick, or you can make a ringed wall up to 20 feet in diameter, 20 feet high, and 1 foot thick. The wall vanishes when the spell ends. The wall's space is difficult terrain. Any ranged weapon attack that enters the wall's space has disadvantage on the attack roll, and fire damage is halved if the fire effect passes through the wall to reach its target. Spells that deal cold damage that pass through the wall cause the area of the wall they pass through to freeze solid (at least a 5-foot square section is frozen). Each 5-foot-square frozen section has AC 5 and 15 hit points. Reducing a frozen section to 0 hit points destroys it. When a section is destroyed, the wall's water doesn't fill it.

magic_items.name: Mind Blade
magic_items.description: Mind flayers can turn any nonmagical sword into a mind blade. Only one creature can attune to it: either a specific mind flayer or one of its thralls. In the hands of any other creature, the mind blade functions as a normal sword of its kind. In the hands of its intended wielder, the mind blade is a magic weapon that deals an extra 2d6 psychic damage to any target it hits.

magic_items.name: Mind Carapace Armor
magic_items.description: Any nonmagical suit of heavy armor can be turned by mind flayers into mind carapace armor. Only one creature can attune to it: either a specific mind flayer or one of its thralls. While worn by any other creature, the mind carapace armor functions as normal armor of its kind. To its intended wearer, the armor grants advantage on Intelligence, Wisdom, and Charisma saving throws and makes its wearer immune to the frightened condition.

magic_items.name: Mind Lash
magic_items.description: In the hands of a creature other than a mind flayer, a mind lash functions as a normal whip. In the hands of an illithid, this magic weapon strips away a creature's will to survive as it also strips away flesh, dealing an extra 2d4 psychic damage to any target it hits. Any creature that takes psychic damage from the mind lash must also succeed on a DC 15 Wisdom saving throw or have disadvantage on Intelligence, Wisdom, and Charisma saving throws for 1 minute. The creature can repeat the saving throw at the end of each of its turns, ending the effect on itself on a success.

magic_items.name: Shield of Far Sight
magic_items.description: A mind flayer skilled at crafting magic items creates a shield of far sight by harvesting an eye from an intelligent humanoid and magically implanting it on the outer surface of a nonmagical shield. The shield becomes a magic item once the eye is implanted, whereupon the mind flayer can give the shield to a thrall or hang it on a wall in its lair. As long as the shield is on the same plane of existence as its creator, the mind flayer can see through the shield's eye, which has darkvision out to a range of 60 feet. While peering through this magical eye, the mind flayer can use its Mind Blast action as though it were standing behind the shield. If a shield of far sight is destroyed, the mind flayer that created it is blinded for 2d12 hours.

monsters.name: Banderhobb
languages: understands Common and the languages of its creator, but can't speak

features.name: Resonant Connection
features.description: If the banderhobb has even a tiny piece of a creature or an object in its possession, such as a lock of hair or a splinter of wood, it knows the most direct route to that creature or object if it is within 1 mile of the banderhobb.

features.name: Shadow Stealth
features.description: While in dim light or darkness, the banderhobb can take the Hide action as a bonus action.

actions.name: Bite
actions.description: Melee Weapon Attack: +8 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 22 (5d6 + 5) piercing damage, and the target is grappled (escape DC 15) if it is a Large or smaller creature. Until this grapple ends, the target is restrained, and the banderhobb can't use its bite attack or tongue attack on another target.

actions.name: Tongue
actions.description: Melee Weapon Attack: +8 to hit, reach 15 ft., one creature. Hit: 10 (3d6) necrotic damage, and the target must make a DC 15 Strength saving throw. On a failed save, the target is pulled to a space within 5 feet of the banderhobb, which can use a bonus action to make a bite attack against the target.

actions.name: Swallow
actions.description: The banderhobb makes a bite attack against a Medium or smaller creature it is grappling. If the attack hits, the creature is swallowed, and the grapple ends. The swallowed creature is blinded and restrained, it has total cover against attacks and other effects outside the banderhobb, and it takes 10 (3d6) necrotic damage at the start of each of the banderhobb's turns. A creature reduced to 0 hit points in this way stops taking the necrotic damage and becomes stable. The banderhobb can have only one creature swallowed at a time. While the banderhobb isn't incapacitated, it can regurgitate the creature at any time (no action required) in a space within 5 feet of it. The creature exits prone. If the banderhobb dies, it likewise regurgitates a swallowed creature.

actions.name: Shadow Step
actions.description: The banderhobb magically teleports up to 30 feet to an unoccupied space of dim light or darkness that it can see. Before or after teleporting, it can make a bite or tongue attack.

monsters.name: Barghest
damage_resistances: bludgeoning, piercing, and slashing from nonmagical attacks
monsters.senses: blindsight 60 ft., darkvision 60 ft., passive Perception 15

features.name: Shapechanger
features.description: The barghest can use its action to polymorph into a Small goblin or back into its true form. Other than its size and speed, its statistics are the same in each form. Any equipment it is wearing or carrying isn't transformed. The barghest reverts to its true form if it dies.

features.name: Fire Banishment
features.description: When the barghest starts its turn engulfed in flames that are at least 10 feet high or wide, it must succeed on a DC 15 Charisma saving throw or be instantly banished to Gehenna. Instantaneous bursts of flame (such as a red dragon's breath or a fireball spell) don't have this effect on the barghest.

features.name: Keen Smell
features.description: The barghest has advantage on Wisdom (Perception) checks that rely on smell.

features.name: Innate Spellcasting
features.description:
The barghest's innate spellcasting ability is Charisma (spell save DC 12). The barghest can innately cast the following spells, requiring no material components:
At will: levitate, minor illusion, pass without trace
1/day each: charm person, dimension door, suggestion

actions.name: Bite
actions.description: Melee Weapon Attack (true form only): +6 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 13 (2d8 + 4) piercing damage.

actions.name: Claws
actions.description: Melee Weapon Attack. +6 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 8 (1d8 + 4) slashing damage.

features.name: Lightning Blood
features.description: A creature within 5 feet of the death kiss takes 5 (1d10) lightning damage whenever it hits the death kiss with a melee attack that deals piercing or slashing damage.

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.description: The death kiss makes three tentacle attacks. Up to three of these attacks can be replaced by Blood Drain, one replacement per tentacle grappling a creature.

actions.name: Tentacle
actions.description: Melee Weapon Attack: +8 to hit, reach 20 ft., one target. Hit: 14 (3d6 + 4) piercing damage, and the target is grappled (escape DC 14) if it is a Huge or smaller creature. Until this grapple ends, the target is restrained, and the death kiss can't use the same tentacle on another target. The death kiss has ten tentacles.

actions.name: Blood Drain
actions.description: One creature grappled by a tentacle of the death kiss must make a DC 16 Constitution saving throw. On a failed save, the target takes 22 (4d10) lightning damage, and the death kiss regains half as many hit points.

features.name: Stunning Gaze
features.description: When a creature that can see the gauth's central eye starts its turn within 30 feet of the gauth, the gauth can force it to make a DC 14 Wisdom saving throw if the gauth isn't incapacitated and can see the creature. A creature that fails the save is stunned until the start of its next turn. Unless surprised, a creature can avert its eyes at the start of its turn to avoid the saving throw. If the creature does so, it can't see the gauth until the start of its next turn, when it can avert its eyes again. If the creature looks at the gauth in the meantime, it must immediately make the save.

features.name: Death Throes
features.description: When the gauth dies, the magical energy within it explodes, and each creature within 10 feet of it must make a DC 14 Dexterity saving throw, taking 13 (3d8) force damage on a failed save, or half as much damage on a successful one.

actions.name: Bite
actions.description: Melee Weapon Attack: +6 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 9 (2d8) piercing damage.

actions.name: Eye Rays
actions.description: The gauth shoots three of the following magical eye rays at random (reroll duplicates), choosing one to three targets it can see within 120 feet of it: 1. Devour Magic Ray. The targeted creature must succeed on a DC 14 Dexterity saving throw or have one of its magic items lose all magical properties until the start of the gauth's next turn. If the object is a charged item, it also loses 1d4 charges. Determine the affected item randomly, ignoring single-use items such as potions and scrolls. 2. Enervation Ray. The targeted creature must make a DC 14 Constitution saving throw, taking 18 (4d8) necrotic damage on a failed save, or half as much damage on a successful one. 3. Pushing Ray. The targeted creature must succeed on a DC 14 Strength saving throw or be pushed up to 15 feet directly away from the gauth and have its speed halved until the start of the gauth's next turn. 4. Fire Ray. The targeted creature must succeed on a DC 14 Dexterity saving throw or take 22 (4d10) fire damage. 5. Paralyzing Ray. The targeted creature must succeed on a DC 14 Constitution saving throw or be paralyzed for 1 minute. The target can repeat the saving throw at the end of each of its turns, ending the effect on itself on a success. 6. Sleep Ray. The targeted creature must succeed on a DC 14 Wisdom saving throw or fall asleep and remain unconscious for 1 minute. The target awakens if it takes damage or another creature takes an action to wake it. This ray has no effect on constructs and undead.

features.name: Aggressive
features.description: As a bonus action, the gazer can move up to its speed toward a hostile creature that it can see.

features.name: Mimicry
features.description: The gazer can mimic simple sounds of speech it has heard, in any language. A creature that hears the sounds can tell they are imitations with a successful DC 10 Wisdom (Insight) check.

actions.name: Bite
actions.description: Melee Weapon Attack: +5 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 1 piercing damage.

actions.name: Eye Rays
actions.description: The gazer shoots two of the following magical eye rays at random (reroll duplicates), choosing one or two targets it can see within 60 feet of it: 1. Dazing Ray. The targeted creature must succeed on a DC 12 Wisdom saving throw or be charmed until the start of the gazer's next turn. While the target is charmed in this way, its speed is halved, and it has disadvantage on attack rolls. 2. Fear Ray. The targeted creature must succeed on a DC 12 Wisdom saving throw or be frightened until the start of the gazer's next turn. 3. Frost Ray. The targeted creature must succeed on a DC 12 Dexterity saving throw or take 10 (3d6) cold damage. 4. Telekinetic Ray. If the target is a creature that is Medium or smaller, it must succeed on a DC 12 Strength saving throw or be moved up to 30 feet directly away from the gazer. If the target is an object weighing 10 pounds or less that isn't being worn or carried, the gazer moves it up to 30 feet in any direction. The gazer can also exert fine control on objects with this ray, such as manipulating a simple tool or opening a container.

monsters.name: Bodak
damage_resistances: bludgeoning, piercing, and slashing from nonmagical attacks
languages: the languages it knew in life

features.name: Aura of Annihilation
features.description: The bodak can activate or deactivate this feature as a bonus action. While active, the aura deals 5 necrotic damage to any creature that ends its turn within 30 feet of the bodak. Undead and fiends ignore this effect.

features.name: Death Gaze
features.description:
When a creature that can see the bodak's eyes starts its turn within 30 feet of the bodak, the bodak can force it to make a DC 13 Constitution saving throw if the bodak isn't incapacitated and can see the creature. If the saving throw fails by 5 or more, the creature is reduced to 0 hit points, unless it is immune to the frightened condition. Otherwise, a creature takes 16 (3d10) psychic damage on a failed save.
Unless surprised, a creature can avert its eyes to avoid the saving throw at the start of its turn. If the creature does so, it has disadvantage on attack rolls against the bodak until the start of its next turn. If the creature looks at the bodak in the meantime, it must immediately make the saving throw.

features.name: Sunlight Hypersensitivity
features.description: The bodak takes 5 radiant damage when it starts its turn in sunlight. While in sunlight, it has disadvantage on attack rolls and ability checks.

actions.name: Fist
actions.description: Melee Weapon Attack: +5 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 4 (1d4 + 2) bludgeoning damage plus 9 (2d8) necrotic damage.

actions.name: Withering Gaze
actions.description: One creature that the bodak can see within 60 feet of it must make a DC 13 Constitution saving throw, taking 22 (4d10) necrotic damage on a failed save, or half as much damage on a successful one.

features.name: Boggle Oil
features.description: The boggle excretes nonflammable oil from its pores. The boggle chooses whether the oil is slippery or sticky and can change the oil on its skin from one consistency to another as a bonus action. Slippery Oil: While coated in slippery oil, the boggle gains advantage on Dexterity (Acrobatics) checks made to escape bonds, squeeze through narrow spaces, and end grapples. Sticky Oil: While coated in sticky oil, the boggle gains advantage on Strength (Athletics) checks made to grapple and any ability check made to maintain a hold on another creature, a surface, or an object. The boggle can also climb difficult surfaces, including upside down on ceilings, without needing to make an ability check.

features.name: Dimensional Rift
features.description: As a bonus action, the boggle can create an invisible and immobile rift within an opening or frame it can see within 5 feet of it, provided that the space is no bigger than 10 feet on any side. The dimensional rift bridges the distance between that space and any point within 30 feet of it that the boggle can see or specify by distance and direction (such as "30 feet straight up"). While next to the rift, the boggle can see through it and is considered to be next to the destination as well, and anything the boggle puts through the rift (including a portion of its body) emerges at the destination. Only the boggle can use the rift, and it lasts until the end of the boggle's next turn.

features.name: Uncanny Smell
features.description: The boggle has advantage on Wisdom (Perception) checks that rely on smell.

actions.name: Pummel
actions.description: Melee Weapon Attack: +1 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 2 (1d6 - 1) bludgeoning damage.

actions.name: Oil Puddle
actions.description: The boggle creates a puddle of oil that is either slippery or sticky (boggle's choice). The puddle is 1 inch deep and covers the ground in the boggle's space. The puddle is difficult terrain for all creatures except boggles and lasts for 1 hour. If the oil is slippery, any creature that enters the puddle's area or starts its turn there must succeed on a DC 11 Dexterity saving throw or fall prone. If the oil is sticky, any creature that enters the puddle's area or starts its turn there must succeed on a DC 11 Strength saving throw or be restrained. On its turn, a creature can use an action to try to extricate itself from the sticky puddle, ending the effect and moving into the nearest safe unoccupied space with a successful DC 11 Strength check.

features.name: Keen Smell
features.description: The catoblepas has advantage on Wisdom (Perception) checks that rely on smell.

features.name: Stench
features.description: Any creature other than a catoblepas that starts its turn within 10 feet of the catoblepas must succeed on a DC 16 Constitution saving throw or be poisoned until the start of the creature's next turn. On a successful saving throw, the creature is immune to the stench of any catoblepas for 1 hour.

actions.name: Tail
actions.description: Melee Weapon Attack: +7 to hit, reach 10 ft., one target. Hit: 21 (5d6 + 4) bludgeoning damage, and the target must succeed on a DC 16 Constitution saving throw or be stunned until the start of the catoblepas's next turn.

actions.name: Death Ray (Recharge 5-6)
actions.description: The catoblepas targets a creature that it can see within 30 feet of it. The target must make a DC 16 Constitution saving throw, taking 36 (8d8) necrotic damage on a failed save, or half as much damage on a successful one. If the saving throw fails by 5 or more, the target instead takes 64 necrotic damage. The target dies if reduced to 0 hit points by this ray.

features.name: Adhesive Filament
features.description: The cave fisher can use its action to extend a sticky filament up to 60 feet, and the filament adheres to anything that touches it. A creature adhered to the filament is grappled by the cave fisher {escape DC 13), and ability checks made to escape this grapple have disadvantage. The filament can be attacked (AC 15; 5 hit points; immunity to poison and psychic damage), but a weapon that fails to sever it becomes stuck to it, requiring an action and a successful DC 13 Strength check to pull free. Destroying the filament deals no damage to the cave fisher, which can extrude a replacement filament on its next turn.

features.name: Flammable Blood
features.description: If the cave fisher drops to half its hit points or fewer, it gains vulnerability to fire damage.

features.name: Spider Climb
features.description: The cave fisher can climb difficult surfaces, including upside down on ceilings, without needing to make an ability check.

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.description: The cave fisher makes two attacks with its claws.

actions.name: Claw
actions.description: Melee Weapon Attack: +5 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 10 {2d6 + 3) slashing damage.

actions.name: Filament
actions.description: One creature grappled by the cave fisher's adhesive filament must make a DC 13 Strength saving throw, provided that the target weighs 200 pounds or less. On a failure, the target is pulled into an unoccupied space within 5 feet of the cave fisher, and the cave fisher makes a claw attack against it as a bonus action. Reeling up the target releases anyone else who was attached to the filament. Until the grapple ends on the target, the cave fisher can't extrude another filament.

features.name: Fey Ancestry
features.description: The choldrith has advantage on saving throws against being charmed, and magic can't put the choldrith to sleep.

features.name: Spellcasting
features.description:
The choldrith is a 4th-level spellcaster. Its spellcasting ability is Wisdom (save DC 12, +4 to hit with spell attacks). The choldrith has the following cleric spells prepared:
Cantrips (at will): guidance, mending, resistance, thaumaturgy
1st level (4 slots): bane, healing word, sanctuary, shield of faith
2nd level (3 slots): hold person, spiritual weapon (dagger)

features.name: Spider Climb
features.description: The choldrith can climb difficult surfaces, including upside down on ceilings, without needing to make an ability check.

features.name: Sunlight Sensitivity
features.description: While in sunlight, the choldrith has disadvantage on attack rolls, as well as on Wisdom (Perception) checks that rely on sight.

features.name: Web Sense
features.description: While in contact with a web, the choldrith knows the exact location of any other creature in contact with the same web.

features.name: Web Walker
features.description: The choldrith ignores movement restrictions caused by webbing.

actions.name: Dagger
actions.description: Melee or Ranged Weapon Attack: +5 to hit, reach 5 ft. or range 20/60 ft., one target. Hit: 5 (1d4 + 3) piercing damage plus 10 (3d6) poison damage.

actions.name: Web (Recharge 5-6)
actions.description: Ranged Weapon Attack: +5 to hit, range 30/60 ft., one Large or smaller creature. Hit: The target is restrained by webbing. As an action, the restrained target can make a DC 11 Strength check, bursting the webbing on a success. The webbing can also be attacked and destroyed (AC 10; 5 hit points; vulnerability to fire damage; immunity to bludgeoning, poison, and psychic damage).

features.name: Illumination
features.description: As a bonus action, the cranium rat can shed dim light from its brain in a 5-foot radius or extinguish the light.

features.name: Telepathic Shroud
features.description: The cranium rat is immune to any effect that would sense its emotions or read its thoughts, as well as to all divination spells.

actions.name: Bite
actions.description: Melee Weapon Attack: +4 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 1 piercing damage.

features.name: Illumination
features.description: As a bonus action, the swarm can shed dim light from its brains in a 5-foot radius, increase the illumination to bright light in a 5- to 20-foot radius (and dim light for an additional number of feet equal to the chosen radius), or extinguish the light.

features.name: Innate Spellcasting (Psionics)
features.description:
The swarm's innate spellcasting ability is Intelligence (spell save DC 13). As long as it has more than half of its hit points remaining, the swarm can innately cast the following spells, requiring no components:
At will: command, comprehend languages, detect thoughts
1/day each: confusion, dominate monster

features.name: Swarm
features.description: The swarm can occupy another creature's space and vice versa, and the swarm can move through any opening large enough for a Tiny rat. The swarm can't regain hit points or gain temporary hit points.

features.name: Telepathic Shroud
features.description: The swarm is immune to any effect that would sense its emotions or read its thoughts, as well as to all divination spells.

actions.name: Bites
actions.description: Melee Weapon Attack: +5 to hit, reach 0 ft., one target in the swarm's space. Hit: 14 (4d6) piercing damage, or 7 (2d6) piercing damage if the swarm has half of its hit points or fewer.

monsters.name: Darkling
monsters.senses: blindsight 30 ft., darkvision 120 ft., passive Perception 15

features.name: Death Flash
features.description: When the darkling dies, nonmagical light flashes out from it in a 10-foot radius as its body and possessions, other than metal or magic objects, burn to ash. Any creature in that area and able to see the bright light must succeed on a DC 10 Constitution saving throw or be blinded until the end of the creature's next turn.

features.name: Light Sensitivity
features.description: While in bright light, the darkling has disadvantage on attack rolls, as well as on Wisdom (Perception) checks that rely on sight.

actions.name: Dagger
actions.description: Melee or Ranged Weapon Attack: +5 to hit, reach 5 ft. or range 20/60 ft., one target. Hit: 5 (1d4 + 3) piercing damage. If the darkling has advantage on the attack roll, the attack deals an extra 7 (2d6) piercing damage.

monsters.name: Darkling Elder
monsters.senses: blindsight 30 ft., darkvision 120 ft., passive Perception 16

features.name: Death Burn
features.description: When the darkling elder dies, magical light flashes out from it in a 10-foot radius as its body and possessions, other than metal or magic objects, burn to ash. Any creature in that area must make a DC 11 Constitution saving throw. On a failure, the creature takes 7 (2d6) radiant damage and, if the creature can see the light, is blinded until the end of its next turn. If the saving throw is successful, the creature takes half the damage and isn't blinded.

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.description: The darkling elder makes two melee attacks.

actions.name: Shortsword
actions.description: Melee Weapon Attack: +5 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 6 (1d6 + 3) piercing damage. If the darkling elder had advantage on the attack roll, the attack deals an extra 10 (3d6) piercing damage.

actions.name: Darkness (Recharges after a Short or Long Rest)
actions.description: The darkling elder casts darkness without any components. Wisdom is its spellcasting ability.

monsters.name: Deep Scion
monsters.speed: 30 ft. (20 ft. and swim 40 ft. in hybrid form)

features.name: Shapechanger
features.description: The deep scion can use its action to polymorph into a humanoid-piscine hybrid form, or back into its true form. Its statistics, other than its speed, are the same in each form. Any equipment it is wearing or carrying isn't transformed. The deep scion reverts to its true form if it dies.

features.name: Amphibious (Hybrid Form Only)
features.description: The deep scion can breathe air and water.

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.description: In humanoid form, the deep scion makes two melee attacks. In hybrid form, the deep scion makes three attacks: one with its bite and two with its claws.

actions.name: Battleaxe (Humanoid Form Only)
actions.description: Melee Weapon Attack: +6 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 8 (1d8 + 4) slashing damage, or 9 (1d10 + 4) slashing damage if used with two hands.

actions.name: Bite (Hybrid Form Only)
actions.description: Melee Weapon Attack: +6 to hit, reach 5 ft., one creature. Hit: 6 (1d4 + 4) piercing damage.

actions.name: Claw (Hybrid Form Only)
actions.description: Melee Weapon Attack: +6 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 7 (1d6 + 4) slashing damage.

actions.name: Psychic Screech (Hybrid Form Only; Recharges after a Short or Long Rest)
actions.description: The deep scion emits a terrible scream audible within 300 feet. Creatures within 30 feet of the deep scion must succeed on a DC 13 Wisdom saving throw or be stunned until the end of the deep scion's next turn. In water, the psychic screech also telepathically transmits the deep scion's memories of the last 24 hours to its master, regardless of distance, so long as it and its master are in the same body of water.

monsters.name: Babau
damage_resistances: bludgeoning, piercing, and slashing from nonmagical attacks

features.name: Innate Spellcasting
features.description:
The babau's innate spellcasting ability is Wisdom (spell save DC 11). The babau can innately cast the following spells, requiring no material components:
At will: darkness, dispel magic, fear, heat metal, levitate

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.description: The babau makes two melee attacks. It can also use Weakening Gaze before or after making these attacks.

actions.name: Claw
actions.description: Melee Weapon Attack: +6 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 8 (1d8 + 4) slashing damage.

actions.name: Spear
actions.description: Melee or Ranged Weapon Attack: +6 to hit, reach 5 ft. or range 20/60 ft., one target. Hit: 7 (1d6 + 4) piercing damage, or 8 (1d8 + 4) piercing damage when used with two hands to make a melee attack.

actions.name: Weakening Gaze
actions.description: The babau targets one creature that it can see within 20 feet of it. The target must make a DC 13 Constitution saving throw. On a failed save, the target deals only half damage with weapon attacks that use Strength for 1 minute. The target can repeat the saving throw at the end of each of its turns, ending the effect on itself on a success.

features.name: Rampage
features.description: When it reduces a creature to 0 hit points with a melee attack on its turn, the maw demon can take a bonus action to move up to half its speed and make a bite attack.

actions.name: Bite
actions.description: Melee Weapon Attack: +4 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 11 (2d8 + 2) piercing damage.

monsters.name: Shoosuva
damage_resistances: bludgeoning, piercing, and slashing from nonmagical attacks

features.name: Rampage
features.description: When it reduces a creature to 0 hit points with a melee attack on its turn, the shoosuva can take a bonus action to move up to half its speed and make a bite attack.

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.description: The shoosuva makes two attacks: one with its bite and one with its tail stinger.

actions.name: Bite
actions.description: Melee Weapon Attack: +7 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 26 (4d10 + 4) piercing damage.

actions.name: Tail Stinger
actions.description: Melee Weapon Attack: +7 to hit, reach 15 ft., one creature. actions.description: The elder brain targets one incapacitated creature it can perceive with its Creature Sense trait and establishes a psychic link with that creature. Until the psychic link ends, the elder brain can perceive everything the target senses. The target becomes aware that something is linked to its mind once it is no longer incapacitated, and the elder brain can terminate the link at any time (no action required). The target can use an action on its turn to attempt to break the psychic link, doing so with a successful DC 18 Charisma saving throw. On a successful save, the target takes 10 (3d6) psychic damage. The psychic link also ends if the target and the elder brain are more than 5 miles apart, with no consequences to the target. The elder brain can form psychic links with up to ten creatures at a time.

actions.name: Sense Thoughts
actions.description: The elder brain targets a creature with which it has a psychic link. The elder brain gains insight into the target's reasoning, its emotional state, and thoughts that loom large in its mind (including things the target worries about, loves, or hates). The elder brain can also make a Charisma (Deception) check with advantage to deceive the target's mind into thinking it believes one idea or feels a particular emotion. The target contests this attempt with a Wisdom (Insight) check. If the elder brain succeeds, the mind believes the deception for 1 hour or until evidence of the lie is presented to the target.

The ulitharid can maintain its psychic link with the elder brain regardless of the distance between them, so long as they are both on the same plane of existence. If the ulitharid is more than 5 miles away from the elder brain, it can end the psychic link at any time (no action required).

reactions.description:
The enchanter tries to magically divert an attack made against it, provided that the attacker is with in 30 feet of it and visible to it. The enchanter must decide to do so before the attack hits or misses.
The attacker must make a DC 14 Wisdom saving throw. On a failed save, the attacker targets the creature closest to it, other than the enchanter or itself. If multiple creatures are closest, the attacker chooses which one to target.

At will: disguise self, mage armor (self only), silent image, speak with animals
1/day: conjure fey

features.description:
The warlock is a 11th-level spellcaster. Its spellcasting ability is Charisma (spell save DC 14, +6 to hit with spell attacks). It regains its expended spell slots when it finishes a short or long rest. It knows the following warlock spells:
Cantrips (at will): dancing lights, eldritch blast, friends, mage hand, minor illusion, prestidigitation, vicious mockery
1st-5th level (3 5th-level slots): blink, charm person, dimension door, dominate beast, faerie fire, fear, hold monster, misty step, phantasmal force, seeming, sleep

reactions.name: Misty Escape (Recharges after a Short or Long Rest)
reactions.description: In response to taking damage, the warlock turns invisible and teleports up to 60 feet to an unoccupied space it can see. It remains invisible until the start of its next turn or until it attacks, makes a damage roll, or casts a spell.

At will: alter self, false life, levitate (self only), mage armor (self only), silent image

Cantrips (at will): eldritch blast, fire bolt, friends, mage hand, minor illusion, prestidigitation, shocking grasp
1st-5th level (4 5th-level slots): banishment, burning hands, flame strike, hellish rebuke, magic circle, scorching ray, scrying, stinking cloud, suggestion, wall of fire

features.name: Dark One's Own Luck (Recharges after a Short or Long Rest)
features.description: When the warlock makes an ability check or saving throw, it can add a d10 to the roll. It can do this after the roll is made but before any of the roll's effects occur.

actions.name: Mace
actions.description: Melee Weapon Attack: +3 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 3 (1d6) bludgeoning damage plus 10 (3d6) fire damage.

monsters.name: Warlock of the Great Old One

features.name: Innate Spellcasting
features.description:
The warlock's innate spellcasting ability is Charisma. It can innately cast the following spells (spell save DC 15), requiring no material components:
At will: detect magic, jump, levitate, mage armor (self only), speak with dead
1/day each: arcane gate, true seeing

Cantrips (at will): chill touch, eldritch blast, guidance, mage hand, minor illusion, prestidigitation, shocking grasp
1st-5th level (3 5th-level slots): armor of Agathys, arms of Hadar, crown of madness, clairvoyance, contact other plane, detect thoughts, dimension door, dissonant whispers, dominate beast, telekinesis, vampiric touch

features.name: Whispering Aura

features.name: Survivor
features.description: The warlord regains 10 hit points at the start of its turn if it has at least 1 hit point but fewer hit points than half its hit point maximum.

actions.name: Multiattack
